description: Fragment of a letter from Salāma b. Ibrāhīm, probably in Būṣīr, to Nahray b. Nissim, probably in Fustat. Around 1055. Probably referring to a purchase of flax. The identity of sender and the origin and the subject are all extrapolated by Gil. (Information from Gil, Kingdom, Vol. 4, #766) VMR
description_he: שרידי מכתב מסלאמה בן אברהים, כנראה מבוסיר, לנהראי בן ניסים, פוסטאט, כ-1055, על פשתן
